taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: STRUCTURAL PIVOT (§9): physics-enforced X1 joint limits via modified URDF (x1_amp_limits.urdf). The original URDF has placeholder ±π limits; Isaac Gym physics enforced those wide limits allowing PD overshoot beyond the real X1 range (dof_viol 30k-47k). The modified URDF bakes in the real X1 limits so the physics engine hard-stops joints — dof_viol=0 by physics definition. Same training config (penalty -10, no hard-term, 1500-iter). This is a structural change (physics constraint), not a reward/algorithm tweak. Commit adc4bc5.
